detail:
New decision "Contracts draft.2 accepted the slice's eight proposals as additive changes (local_persisted→admitted, signer_unknown/no_policy_yet quarantine, unauthorized reject, CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE, corrected.by, part-level revoke/override, per-part scope, ruling parts + machine-checkable requirements, propose role, typed evidence_class); admission order is parents/endpoints before capability with no-policy-yet as a retryable quarantine; archived is a flag beside an untouched status; a human key becomes a trusted signer only via out-of-band bootstrap or a principal event signed by an already-trusted human key" relates to:
- 01M2KFYG0KGQT5SRZSG4MKP3CK: "ADR docs/adr/2026-09-foundation-contracts.md ACCEPTED (draft 2): the immutable event log + deterministic projections + delivery state machine + ingress-decided evidence classes are the v3 foundation; amendments after acceptance are recorded as supersessions in the programme log"
- 01M2KFYG2XTN3SKA4A76GSYQ50: "Corrected ADR §12: the governing scoped correction in the slice scenario is authored by the ruling's own human principal (class human_ruling); a verified_observation correction of a ruling is contested, not governing — the class-rank mechanism is right and the draft-1 wording was wrong"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 2 existing decision(s) overlap
